categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Fines resolved through prompt payment, maximizing timely fine revenue and helping minimize administrative and enforcement cost, judged against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 12, supported by variants such as V0002.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Enforced cases resolved through delayed payment after notification and penalty additions, helping maximize timely fine revenue, judged against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 13, supported by variants such as V0004 and V0005 where payment occurs after penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Contested cases resolved through the administrative appeal process involving the Prefecture, preserving due-process rights while potentially increasing costs and delaying revenue, judged against time to appeal filing, Prefecture.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 14, observed in variants handling prefecture appeals like V0008 and V0057.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Contested cases resolved via judicial appeal to a judge, strongly making offender due-process rights while hurting administrative costs, judged against time to appeal filing, Judge.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 19, evidenced in variants containing judicial appeals such as V0103 and V0176.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases resolved via coercive credit collection actions after enforcement steps, helping revenue but hurting administrative costs, judged against average time to case closure.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 20, observed in frequent credit collection outcomes such as V0001 and V0009.
